criteria.name: Mission concept and rationale — What will it do, who are the users, why is it needed?
criteria.reasoning: Clear need, function and users identified with SST, thermal stress, bathymetry and colour-change detection. Supported by NOAA, National Geographic, Nature refs. Lacks formal objectives/requirements statement.

evidence.quote: A near-real-time relay to monitoring stations on the ground would allow marine and conservation scientists to more accurately predict and react to coral bleaching events.
Australia’s Great Barrier Reef is the largest coral reef in the world, spread over 344,400 km².

criteria.name: Project plan — How you plan to complete the assignment, including either a Gantt chart or a timetable and information sources you plan to use
criteria.reasoning: Gantt Wk2-Wk10 with launch, orbit, ground, comms, EOL, STK and editing plus task paragraphs and Week 10 buffer. Sources listed. No explicit variation/contingency discussion beyond buffer.

evidence.quote: Project work will be divided into weeks via a Gantt Chart.

criteria.name: Preliminary progress — Technical content and evidence of sufficient work done to date
criteria.reasoning: No calculations, COEs, orbit values, simulation plots or design results shown. Only background reading and claimed STK tutorials without evidence. Minor preparatory work only.

criteria.name: Report presentation
criteria.reasoning: Clear headings, readable writing and labelled Gantt with legend. References are bare URLs and Useful Links not cited in text, not proper citation style.

evidence.quote: Completed stages are gold. Incomplete stages are blue. Deadlines are indicated by red lines.

overall: Good relevant reef-monitoring concept and feasible plan using STK. Presentation adequate. Lacks preliminary technical results needed to confirm progress.

feedback.summary: You presented a relevant Great Barrier Reef monitoring concept with clear users and a feasible STK-based plan. Your Gantt and writing are clear. To progress, add formal requirements, contingency detail, preliminary technical results with evidence, and proper citations.
next_steps: Formalise mission objectives and requirements for SST, thermal stress, bathymetry and colour-change detection in Mission Concept & Rationale.
Add orbit calculations, COEs and STK plots with interpretation in Project Plan & Preliminary Progress to show technical progress.
Convert Useful Links bare URLs to proper in-text citations and add explicit contingency discussion to your Gantt plan.

criteria.C1: You did well in Mission Concept & Rationale identifying the 344,400 km² reef need, near-real-time relay function and scientist users for bleaching prediction. For top Accomplished, add a formal objectives and requirements statement linking SST, thermal stress, bathymetry and colour-change functions to user needs with literature references.
criteria.C2: You provided a feasible Wk2-Wk10 Gantt in Image 1 with launch, orbit, ground, comms, EOL tasks and Week 10 buffer plus sources in Useful Links. For full Accomplished, explain why the sequence fits your reef mission narrative and add explicit provision for variations and contingencies beyond the buffer.
criteria.C3: You noted background reading and STK tutorials 1-4 in Project Plan & Preliminary Progress, showing preparation. For Accomplished, you need a preliminary set of results with description: include calculations, orbit values/COEs and STK simulation plots to show you are on track.
criteria.C4: Your report in Project Plan & Preliminary Progress is readable with clear headings and your Image 1 Gantt legend explains gold/blue stages and red deadlines. For Accomplished, you need consistent professional formatting and proper citations: replace bare URLs in Useful Links with in-text citations matching a formatted reference list.
